questions.question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the sentence:
"An increase in crimes against women have been reported in the newspapers recently."
questions.explanation: The subject is 'An increase' (singular), so the verb must be singular: 'has been reported'. 'In crimes against women' is only a prepositional phrase.

questions.question:
Choose the word which best expresses the meaning of the given word:
OBNOXIOUS
questions.explanation: 'Obnoxious' means extremely unpleasant or offensive, i.e. disgusting. 'Delightful' is its opposite.

questions.question:
Choose the one word which can be substituted for the given words:
A political leader who tries to stir up people
questions.explanation: A demagogue appeals to people's emotions and prejudices to stir them up. A dictator rules absolutely; a statesman is a wise, respected leader.

questions.question:
Read the passage and answer the question.
"In the past 50 years, doctors across the world have accepted the practice to prescribe antibiotics at the first sign of a trivial infection or treat patients with a handful of antibiotics. These days it is not uncommon to see practitioners prescribing multiple antibiotics without any real indication or relevance for such a combination of drugs. Antibiotics have traditionally been known as miracle drugs, but there is growing evidence that they are overworked miracles, especially in countries like ours where there is easy access to drugs across the counter, including antibiotics. We cannot think of a return to pre-antibiotics days. Yet the unbridled use of these agents is inexorably propelling us in that direction."

Antibiotics are called 'overworked miracles' because:
questions.explanation: The passage says antibiotics are prescribed even for trivial infections and in combinations without need, i.e. they are over-used.

questions.question: इनमें स्त्रीलिंग शब्द कौन-सा है?
questions.explanation: 'रचना' स्त्रीलिंग है (अच्छी रचना)। सृजन, संपादन और विकास पुल्लिंग शब्द हैं।

questions.question: 'घोड़ों का घर कितनी दूर' इस लोकोक्ति का सही अर्थ है:

options.A: जो इच्छा करता है वही प्राप्त करता है।
options.B: तेजी से काम करने से वह जल्दी निपट जाता है।
options.C: घर से दूर रहने वाला दुखी रहता है।
options.D: कर्मठ व्यक्ति के लिए सफलता सरल होती है।

questions.explanation: जैसे तेज़ घोड़े के लिए घर दूर नहीं होता, वैसे ही परिश्रमी (कर्मठ) व्यक्ति के लिए सफलता कठिन नहीं होती।

questions.question:
नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से उपयुक्त समास छाँटिए:
गजानन
questions.explanation: गजानन = गज के समान आनन है जिसका, अर्थात् गणेश। अन्य पद प्रधान होने से यह बहुव्रीहि समास है।

questions.question: 'निस्' उपसर्ग से बना शब्द निम्न में से कौन-सा है?
questions.explanation: निश्चय = निस् + चय। निर्वास और निर्वाह में 'निर्' उपसर्ग है तथा निबंध में 'नि' उपसर्ग है।

questions.question:
दिए गए शब्द का विलोम चुनें:
साध्य
questions.explanation: साध्य (जो सिद्ध/ठीक किया जा सके) का विलोम असाध्य है।

questions.question: 'बात बोलेगी' के रचनाकार कौन हैं?
questions.explanation: 'बात बोलेगी' प्रयोगवादी-नई कविता के कवि शमशेर बहादुर सिंह की प्रसिद्ध कविता है।

questions.question: 'मुर्दहिया' के लेखक हैं:
questions.explanation: 'मुर्दहिया' (2010) डॉ. तुलसीराम की दलित आत्मकथा है।

questions.question: खड़ी बोली के समर्थकों को हठी और मूर्ख किसने कहा?
questions.explanation: ब्रजभाषा के समर्थक जगन्नाथदास 'रत्नाकर' ने खड़ी बोली के समर्थकों को हठी और मूर्ख कहा था। श्रीधर पाठक तो खड़ी बोली के समर्थक थे।

questions.question: साकेत के किस सर्ग में उर्मिला-लक्ष्मण मिलन वर्णित है?
questions.explanation: मैथिलीशरण गुप्त के 'साकेत' के बारहवें (द्वादश) सर्ग में उर्मिला-लक्ष्मण मिलन है। नवम् सर्ग उर्मिला के विरह-वर्णन के लिए प्रसिद्ध है।

questions.question: 'खच्चर और आदमी' कहानी के लेखक कौन हैं?
questions.explanation: 'खच्चर और आदमी' यशपाल की कहानी है।

questions.question: 'कहानी' पत्रिका का प्रकाशन कब प्रारम्भ हुआ?
questions.explanation: 'कहानी' पत्रिका (नई कहानी आंदोलन से जुड़ी) का प्रकाशन 1955 ई० में प्रारम्भ हुआ।

questions.question:
निम्नलिखित कहानीकारों को उनकी कहानियों के साथ सुमेलित कीजिए:
सूची-1 (कहानीकार): A. फणीश्वरनाथ रेणु, B. अमरकांत, C. उषा प्रियंवदा, D. यशपाल
सूची-2 (कहानी): 1. दोपहर का भोजन, 2. ठेस, 3. परदा, 4. वापसी, 5. पुरस्कार
कूट (A B C D):
questions.explanation: रेणु: ठेस, अमरकांत: दोपहर का भोजन, उषा प्रियंवदा: वापसी, यशपाल: परदा। 'पुरस्कार' जयशंकर प्रसाद की कहानी है।

questions.question: पं० बालकृष्ण भट्ट का प्रथम निबंध कौन सा है?
questions.explanation: बालकृष्ण भट्ट का प्रथम निबंध 'कलिराज की सभा' माना जाता है।

questions.question: 'हिन्दी प्रदीप' कहाँ से निकलता था?
questions.explanation: बालकृष्ण भट्ट ने 'हिन्दी प्रदीप' 1877 में इलाहाबाद (प्रयाग) से निकाला।

questions.question: 'श्रीराम की बोलती प्रतिमा' की रचना विधा है:
questions.explanation: 'श्रीराम की बोलती प्रतिमा' एक रेखाचित्र है।

questions.question: 'जयचंद प्रकाश' ग्रंथ के रचनाकार कौन हैं?
questions.explanation: 'जयचंद प्रकाश' भट्ट केदार की रचना है। मधुकर ने 'जयमयंक जसचंद्रिका' लिखी, जगनिक ने 'परमाल रासो'।

questions.question: पृथ्वीराज रासो की शैली निम्न में से क्या है?
questions.explanation: पृथ्वीराज रासो (चंदबरदाई) की भाषा-शैली पिंगल (ब्रज-प्रधान राजस्थानी) मानी जाती है। डिंगल पश्चिमी राजस्थानी की साहित्यिक शैली है।

questions.question:
गद्यांश को पढ़कर प्रश्न का उत्तर दीजिए:
"एकता के महत्त्व से सम्बन्धित अनेक लोकोक्तियाँ प्रचलित हैं, यथा: दस की लाठी एक का बोझ, अकेला चना भाड़ नहीं फोड़ सकता इत्यादि। एक तिनके की क्या हस्ती? लेकिन जब वही तिनका संगठित होकर रस्सी बन जाता है, तब इससे बलशाली हाथी भी बंध जाता है। एक ईंट की क्या बिसात? लेकिन जब यही ईंटें मिलकर दीवार बनाती हैं, तब उसे तोड़ना मुश्किल हो जाता है। एक बूँद जल का क्या अस्तित्व? लेकिन जब इन्हीं बूँदों के मेल से सागर का निर्माण होता है, तो उसे लाँघना दुष्कर हो जाता है। एक चींटी की क्या औकात? लेकिन जब ये छोटी-सी चींटियाँ एक साथ हो जाती हैं, तब अपने से बड़े आकार के जीवों को चट कर जाती हैं। एकता के महत्त्व से सम्बन्धित एक किसान और उसके बच्चों की और लकड़ी के टुकड़ों की कथा प्रचलित है। लकड़ी के टुकड़े जब अलग-अलग रहते हैं, तब बच्चों द्वारा वे आसानी से तोड़ दिए जाते हैं; परन्तु वे ही टुकड़े जब संगठित होकर गट्ठर बन जाते हैं, तब बच्चे तोड़ नहीं पाते हैं। इन दृष्टान्तों से स्पष्ट है कि 'एकता में ही बल है।'"

तिनके की क्या विशेषता है?

options.A: जब तिनका संगठित होकर रस्सी बन जाता है, तब इससे बलशाली हाथी भी बंध जाता है।
options.C: तिनका घास का काम करता है।

questions.explanation: गद्यांश के अनुसार संगठित तिनके रस्सी बनकर हाथी को भी बाँध लेते हैं।

questions.question:
गद्यांश को पढ़कर प्रश्न का उत्तर दीजिए:
"एकता के महत्त्व से सम्बन्धित अनेक लोकोक्तियाँ प्रचलित हैं, यथा: दस की लाठी एक का बोझ, अकेला चना भाड़ नहीं फोड़ सकता इत्यादि। एक तिनके की क्या हस्ती? लेकिन जब वही तिनका संगठित होकर रस्सी बन जाता है, तब इससे बलशाली हाथी भी बंध जाता है। एक ईंट की क्या बिसात? लेकिन जब यही ईंटें मिलकर दीवार बनाती हैं, तब उसे तोड़ना मुश्किल हो जाता है। एक बूँद जल का क्या अस्तित्व? लेकिन जब इन्हीं बूँदों के मेल से सागर का निर्माण होता है, तो उसे लाँघना दुष्कर हो जाता है। एक चींटी की क्या औकात? लेकिन जब ये छोटी-सी चींटियाँ एक साथ हो जाती हैं, तब अपने से बड़े आकार के जीवों को चट कर जाती हैं। एकता के महत्त्व से सम्बन्धित एक किसान और उसके बच्चों की और लकड़ी के टुकड़ों की कथा प्रचलित है। लकड़ी के टुकड़े जब अलग-अलग रहते हैं, तब बच्चों द्वारा वे आसानी से तोड़ दिए जाते हैं; परन्तु वे ही टुकड़े जब संगठित होकर गट्ठर बन जाते हैं, तब बच्चे तोड़ नहीं पाते हैं। इन दृष्टान्तों से स्पष्ट है कि 'एकता में ही बल है।'"

बूँदों के मेल का क्या महत्त्व है?

options.A: बूँदों के मेल से सागर का निर्माण होता है।
options.C: बूँदों के मेल से कुछ नहीं होता है।
options.D: बूँदों के मेल से बादल बनते हैं।

questions.explanation: गद्यांश में कहा गया है कि बूँदों के मेल से सागर बनता है।

जब चींटियाँ एक साथ हो जाती हैं, तो ... (वाक्य पूरा कीजिए)।

options.D: अपने से बड़े आकार के जीवों को चट कर जाती हैं।

questions.explanation: गद्यांश के अनुसार एकजुट चींटियाँ अपने से बड़े जीवों को चट कर जाती हैं।

questions.question:
गद्यांश को पढ़कर प्रश्न का उत्तर दीजिए:
"एकता के महत्त्व से सम्बन्धित अनेक लोकोक्तियाँ प्रचलित हैं, यथा: दस की लाठी एक का बोझ, अकेला चना भाड़ नहीं फोड़ सकता इत्यादि। एक तिनके की क्या हस्ती? लेकिन जब वही तिनका संगठित होकर रस्सी बन जाता है, तब इससे बलशाली हाथी भी बंध जाता है। एक ईंट की क्या बिसात? लेकिन जब यही ईंटें मिलकर दीवार बनाती हैं, तब उसे तोड़ना मुश्किल हो जाता है। एक बूँद जल का क्या अस्तित्व? लेकिन जब इन्हीं बूँदों के मेल से सागर का निर्माण होता है, तो उसे लाँघना दुष्कर हो जाता है। एक चींटी की क्या औकात? लेकिन जब ये छोटी-सी चींटियाँ एक साथ हो जाती हैं, तब अपने से बड़े आकार के जीवों को चट कर जाती हैं। एकता के महत्त्व से सम्बन्धित एक किसान और उसके बच्चों की और लकड़ी के टुकड़ों की कथा प्रचलित है। लकड़ी के टुकड़े जब अलग-अलग रहते हैं, तब बच्चों द्वारा वे आसानी से तोड़ दिए जाते हैं; परन्तु वे ही टुकड़े जब संगठित होकर गट्ठर बन जाते हैं, तब बच्चे तोड़ नहीं पाते हैं। इन दृष्टान्तों से स्पष्ट है कि 'एकता में ही बल है।'"

'अकेला चना भाड़ नहीं फोड़ सकता' लोकोक्ति का अर्थ है:

options.A: अकेला व्यक्ति कुछ भी कर सकता है।
options.B: अकेला व्यक्ति भाड़ नहीं फोड़ सकता है।
options.D: अकेला व्यक्ति कुछ नहीं कर सकता है।

questions.explanation: इस लोकोक्ति का लाक्षणिक अर्थ है कि अकेला व्यक्ति बड़ा काम नहीं कर सकता।

questions.question:
गद्यांश को पढ़कर प्रश्न का उत्तर दीजिए:
"एकता के महत्त्व से सम्बन्धित अनेक लोकोक्तियाँ प्रचलित हैं, यथा: दस की लाठी एक का बोझ, अकेला चना भाड़ नहीं फोड़ सकता इत्यादि। एक तिनके की क्या हस्ती? लेकिन जब वही तिनका संगठित होकर रस्सी बन जाता है, तब इससे बलशाली हाथी भी बंध जाता है। एक ईंट की क्या बिसात? लेकिन जब यही ईंटें मिलकर दीवार बनाती हैं, तब उसे तोड़ना मुश्किल हो जाता है। एक बूँद जल का क्या अस्तित्व? लेकिन जब इन्हीं बूँदों के मेल से सागर का निर्माण होता है, तो उसे लाँघना दुष्कर हो जाता है। एक चींटी की क्या औकात? लेकिन जब ये छोटी-सी चींटियाँ एक साथ हो जाती हैं, तब अपने से बड़े आकार के जीवों को चट कर जाती हैं। एकता के महत्त्व से सम्बन्धित एक किसान और उसके बच्चों की और लकड़ी के टुकड़ों की कथा प्रचलित है। लकड़ी के टुकड़े जब अलग-अलग रहते हैं, तब बच्चों द्वारा वे आसानी से तोड़ दिए जाते हैं; परन्तु वे ही टुकड़े जब संगठित होकर गट्ठर बन जाते हैं, तब बच्चे तोड़ नहीं पाते हैं। इन दृष्टान्तों से स्पष्ट है कि 'एकता में ही बल है।'"

इस गद्यांश का उपयुक्त शीर्षक है:
questions.explanation: पूरा गद्यांश 'एकता में ही बल है' पर केंद्रित है, अतः 'संगठन में शक्ति है' उपयुक्त शीर्षक है।

questions.question: Name the organization founded by Surendranath Banerjee which merged with the Indian National Congress in 1886.
questions.explanation: Surendranath Banerjee and Ananda Mohan Bose organised the Indian National Conference (1883), which merged with the INC in 1886. The East India Association was founded by Dadabhai Naoroji.

questions.question: Who presided over the second session of the Indian National Congress?
questions.explanation: The second session (Calcutta, 1886) was presided over by Dadabhai Naoroji. W.C. Bonnerjee presided over the first session (Bombay, 1885).

questions.question: In the Kakori conspiracy case, the prime accused Pandit Ramprasad Bismil was hanged in which city of Uttar Pradesh?
questions.explanation: Bismil was hanged in Gorakhpur Jail on 19 December 1927. Ashfaqulla Khan was hanged in Faizabad.

questions.question: Indian Muslims, in general, were not attracted to the militant (extremist) movement because of:

options.A: The policy of the militants to harp on the Hindu past
options.B: Influence of Sir Syed Ahmed Khan on them
options.C: The anti-Muslim attitude of militant leaders
options.D: Their loyalty to the Mughal emperor

questions.explanation: Extremist leaders used Hindu religious symbols and festivals (Ganapati, Shivaji, appeals to the Hindu past), which alienated many Muslims.

questions.question: Who among the following organized the revolutionary organization 'Abhinav Bharat'?
questions.explanation: V.D. Savarkar founded Abhinav Bharat (1904) out of the Mitra Mela. Jatindranath Mukherjee led the Jugantar group; Har Dayal founded the Ghadar Party.

questions.question: Who among the following escaped the trial related to the Kakori incident?
questions.explanation: Chandra Shekhar Azad evaded arrest after Kakori (1925). Bakshi and Mukundi Lal were sentenced, and Rajendra Lahiri was hanged.

questions.question: Who among the following established a republican (provisional) government abroad?
questions.explanation: Raja Mahendra Pratap set up the Provisional Government of India at Kabul in 1915 as its President, with Barkatullah as PM. Bose's Azad Hind government (1943) came later.

questions.question: Who among the following was a critic of the 'Swadeshi' movement and advocated a better relationship between the East and the West?
questions.explanation: Rabindranath Tagore initially supported Swadeshi but later criticised its narrow, coercive turn and championed East-West synthesis (Visva-Bharati).

questions.question: In which State/UT are the Shiwalik hills known as 'Abor'?
questions.explanation: In Arunachal Pradesh the Shiwaliks are called Dafla, Miri, Abor and Mishmi hills. In J&K they are Jammu hills; in Uttarakhand they form the Dhang/Dundwa ranges.

questions.question: Which of the following is the correct decreasing order of the basin area of rivers in India?
questions.explanation: Basin area in India: Ganga (~8.6 lakh sq km), Indus (~3.2 lakh), Godavari (~3.1 lakh), Krishna (~2.6 lakh).

questions.question: Which of the following is a characteristic of the cold weather season in India?
questions.explanation: In the cold season (Dec-Feb) clear skies give warm, sunny days, while strong night-time radiation makes nights cold.

questions.question: Which part of India is affected by western disturbances (western cyclonic disturbances)?
questions.explanation: Western disturbances originate over the Mediterranean and bring winter rain/snow to north and north-west India (Punjab, Haryana, J&K, Himachal).

questions.question: Which of the following States or Union Territories has zero percent forest cover?

options.D: None of these, as no State/UT in India has zero forest cover

questions.explanation: As per the India State of Forest Report, every State/UT has some forest cover. Lakshadweep, in fact, has one of the highest forest cover percentages (~90%).

questions.question: The sensitivity of a particular community or group to a particular disaster is called:
questions.explanation: Social vulnerability refers to how susceptible a community or social group is to a hazard, based on its socio-economic conditions.

questions.question: Which of the following lies in the most damaging MSK IX (or higher) earthquake risk zone?
questions.explanation: The North-East, Kashmir, Himachal, Uttarakhand, Rann of Kutch and Andaman lie in Zone V (MSK IX or more). Tamil Nadu, Rajasthan and Karnataka are low-risk.

questions.question: Which of the following states is most affected by cyclone disasters?
questions.explanation: Odisha, on the Bay of Bengal coast, is among the most cyclone-prone states. The other three are landlocked.

questions.question: If the volume and pressure of a certain quantity of an ideal gas are both halved, then its temperature will:
questions.explanation: PV = nRT, so T is proportional to PV. (P/2)(V/2) = PV/4, so T becomes one-fourth.

questions.question: The supply that cannot pass through a capacitor (condenser) is:
questions.explanation: A capacitor blocks steady DC (infinite reactance at zero frequency) but allows AC to pass.

questions.question: Which of the following is used in making mirrors?
questions.explanation: Ammoniacal silver nitrate (Tollens' reagent) deposits metallic silver on glass in mirror-making. Silver bromide is used in photography.

questions.question: Which is the lightest radioactive element/isotope?
questions.explanation: Tritium (hydrogen-3) is the lightest radioactive isotope. Deuterium is stable; polonium and radium are heavy.

questions.question: Which acid is found in ant stings?
questions.explanation: Ant stings contain methanoic (formic) acid. Acetic acid is in vinegar; tartaric acid in tamarind; citric acid in citrus fruits.

questions.question: Night blindness is caused by the deficiency of:
questions.explanation: Vitamin A is needed to form rhodopsin in the rods of the retina; its deficiency causes night blindness.

questions.question: Which type of medicine is used to treat indigestion (acidity)?
questions.explanation: Antacids (e.g. milk of magnesia) neutralise excess stomach acid. Antihistamines treat allergies; analgesics relieve pain.

questions.question: Which of the following is the basic structural and functional unit of the nervous system?
questions.explanation: The neuron is the basic unit of the nervous system. The nephron is the unit of the kidney.

questions.question: Find the difference between the largest and the smallest two-digit prime numbers.
questions.explanation: Largest two-digit prime = 97, smallest = 11. 97 - 11 = 86.

questions.question: A certain number of persons together deposited Rs. 529. If each person contributed as many rupees as the number of persons, find the number of persons.
questions.explanation: n x n = 529, so n = sqrt(529) = 23.

questions.question: A shop gives a gift coupon to every 30th customer and a free TV to every 100th customer. Which customer will be the first to receive both?
questions.explanation: The first customer to get both is the LCM of 30 and 100 = 300.

questions.question: A student got 80/80 marks in Term 1 and 75/90 marks in Term 2. If the weights given to the two terms are 40% and 60% respectively, find his final percentage (rounded to the nearest integer).
If the cost price is 92% of the selling price, what is the profit percentage?
questions.explanation: Let SP = 100, CP = 92. Profit = 8. Profit% = 8/92 x 100 = 8.70%. (8% would be wrongly computed on SP.)

questions.question: The price of an article is increased by 20% and then two successive discounts of 5% each are given. By what percentage is the selling price higher than the cost price?
questions.explanation: 100 -> 120 -> 114 -> 108.3. SP exceeds CP by 8.3%. (10% wrongly adds the discounts as a flat 10%.)

questions.question: The average of ten numbers is 8. If each number is divided by 2, find the average of the new set of numbers.
questions.explanation: Dividing every number by 2 divides the average by 2: 8 / 2 = 4.

questions.question: Who won the Men's Asian Hockey Champions Trophy 2024?
questions.explanation: India beat hosts China 1-0 in the final at Hulunbuir in September 2024 to win the title for the fifth time.

questions.question: What is India's rank in the Asia Power Index 2024 (Lowy Institute)?
questions.explanation: India rose to 3rd place, overtaking Japan, behind the USA and China.

questions.question: Which airport is (proposed to be) named after Jagadguru Sant Tukaram Maharaj?
questions.explanation: The Maharashtra government approved naming Pune (Lohegaon) Airport after Jagadguru Sant Tukaram Maharaj.

questions.question: Which Union Minister launched the web portal 'Paridhi 24x25' and the AI Taxonomy e-book?
questions.explanation: Union Textiles Minister Giriraj Singh launched them (the AI taxonomy is for Indian apparel, developed with NIFT).

questions.question: Which mission has been launched to promote cruise tourism in India?
questions.explanation: The Cruise Bharat Mission was launched in 2024 by the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways to boost cruise tourism.

questions.question: Exercise 'KAZIND' is held between India and which country?
questions.explanation: KAZIND is the joint military exercise of India and Kazakhstan (KAZakhstan + INDia).

questions.question: Which state government has recently launched the 'Upasthiti' portal?
questions.explanation: Jharkhand launched the 'Upasthiti' portal for attendance monitoring of government employees.

questions.question: Who has become the new chairperson of the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC)?
questions.explanation: Former Defence Secretary Dr. Ajay Kumar was appointed UPSC Chairman in May 2025, succeeding Preeti Sudan. Manoj Soni was an earlier chairman.

questions.question: Belady's Anomaly is a phenomenon that can occur in which page replacement algorithm?
questions.explanation: In FIFO, increasing the number of frames can increase page faults. LRU and Optimal are stack algorithms and never show this anomaly.

questions.question: Which form of Inter-Process Communication (IPC) is typically the fastest on a single machine?
questions.explanation: Shared memory avoids kernel copies after setup; processes read/write the same region directly. Pipes, queues and sockets involve system calls and copying.

questions.question: In database concurrency control, what is Two-Phase Locking (2PL)?

options.B: A protocol that uses only two locks (shared and exclusive)
options.C: A protocol that commits every transaction in two network phases
options.D: A protocol ensuring a transaction releases locks only after it has obtained all its locks (growing phase, then shrinking phase)

questions.explanation: 2PL has a growing phase (acquire only) and a shrinking phase (release only); it guarantees conflict-serializability but does NOT prevent deadlocks. Two-phase commit is a different protocol.

questions.question: A database TRIGGER is a:

options.A: Stored procedure that automatically executes in response to an event (INSERT, DELETE or UPDATE) on a table

questions.explanation: A trigger fires automatically on DML events on a table; it is not called explicitly like a function.

questions.question: In TCP's congestion control mechanism, what happens during a 'timeout' event?

options.A: The congestion window size is doubled
options.B: The threshold is set to the current window size
options.C: The threshold is set to twice the current window size
options.D: The congestion window size is reset to 1 MSS

questions.explanation: On timeout, ssthresh = cwnd/2 and cwnd is reset to 1 MSS, then slow start begins again.

questions.question: Which layer of the OSI model is responsible for character encoding, compression and encryption?
questions.explanation: The Presentation layer (Layer 6) handles translation/encoding, compression and encryption.

questions.question: The Traveling Salesman Problem (optimization version) is an example of which class of problems?
questions.explanation: Optimization TSP is NP-Hard; its decision version ('is there a tour of cost <= k?') is in NP and NP-Hard, hence NP-Complete.

questions.question: What is the main advantage of using an adjacency list representation for a sparse graph over an adjacency matrix?

options.A: It checks for an edge between two vertices faster

questions.explanation: Adjacency list uses O(V + E) space vs O(V^2) for a matrix. The matrix is faster for edge-existence checks (O(1)).

questions.question: A grammar that produces more than one parse tree for the same sentence is called:
questions.explanation: A grammar is ambiguous if some string has more than one parse tree (or leftmost/rightmost derivation).

questions.question: The part of a compiler that is responsible for allocating memory and other resources for the execution of a program is the:
questions.explanation: The run-time environment handles activation records, stack/heap allocation and storage organisation for execution.

questions.question: A data hazard in a processor pipeline, such as 'Read-After-Write' (RAW), occurs when:

options.A: An instruction needs the result of a previous instruction that has not yet been written
options.B: Two instructions try to use the same hardware resource
options.C: A branch instruction alters the pipeline flow

questions.explanation: RAW is a true data dependency. Resource conflicts are structural hazards and branches cause control hazards.

questions.question: Booth's algorithm is used for:
questions.explanation: Booth's algorithm multiplies signed 2's complement numbers efficiently by encoding runs of 1s.

questions.question: What is the key difference between an interface and an abstract class in languages like Java or C#?

options.A: A class can implement multiple interfaces, but can extend only one abstract class
options.B: Abstract classes can have constructors, while interfaces cannot
options.C: Abstract classes can have non-final variables, while interface variables are public static final by default

questions.explanation: All three are valid differences: multiple interfaces vs single class inheritance, constructors only in abstract classes, and interface fields being public static final by default.

questions.question: The SOLID principle 'L' (Liskov Substitution Principle) states that:

options.A: A class should have only one reason to change
options.B: High-level modules should not depend on low-level modules
options.C: Subtypes must be substitutable for their base types
options.D: Clients should not be forced to depend on interfaces they do not use

questions.explanation: LSP: objects of a subclass must be usable wherever the base class is expected. The others are SRP, DIP and ISP.

questions.question: What is 'Software Re-engineering'?

options.B: Porting the software to a new platform
options.C: Reorganizing existing software to improve its maintainability without changing its functionality
options.D: Writing the software again from scratch with new requirements

questions.explanation: Re-engineering restructures/re-documents legacy software for better maintainability while preserving behaviour.

questions.question: Which type of testing verifies that the system meets non-functional requirements like performance, security or usability?
questions.explanation: Non-functional testing covers performance, load, security and usability, as opposed to functional behaviour.

questions.question: In public-key cryptography, what is the role of a Certificate Authority (CA)?

options.A: To issue digital certificates that attest to the public key of an entity

questions.explanation: A CA signs certificates binding a public key to an identity, forming the basis of PKI trust.

questions.question: What is the primary defense against SQL Injection attacks?

options.A: Sanitizing input and using parameterized queries (prepared statements)

questions.explanation: Parameterized queries keep data separate from SQL code, which is the primary defense. A WAF is only an additional layer; HTTPS and passwords do not stop injection.

questions.question: In the context of Deep Learning, what is a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) primarily used for?
questions.explanation: CNNs use convolution filters for spatial features, so they dominate image tasks. Sequential data is the domain of RNNs/Transformers.

questions.question: The CAP theorem in distributed systems states that a system can deliver at most two of which three guarantees?
questions.explanation: CAP = Consistency, Availability, Partition tolerance (Brewer's theorem).

questions.question: A file access method where records can be read or written in any order is known as:
questions.explanation: Direct (random) access lets any block/record be accessed directly by its number.

questions.question: The 'wait-for graph' is a technique used for:
questions.explanation: A cycle in the wait-for graph indicates deadlock (for single-instance resources).

questions.question: A 'cursor' in database programming allows you to:

options.C: Iterate through and process a result set one row at a time
options.D: Create a backup of the database

questions.explanation: A cursor provides row-by-row traversal of a query result set.

questions.question: Boyce-Codd Normal Form (BCNF) is a stricter version of which normal form?
questions.explanation: BCNF strengthens 3NF: every determinant must be a candidate key. 4NF comes after BCNF.

questions.question: The process of converting a private IP address to a public IP address is handled by:
questions.explanation: NAT on the router maps private addresses to public addresses. DHCP assigns IPs, DNS resolves names, ARP maps IP to MAC.

questions.question: What does a DNS 'MX' (Mail Exchange) record specify?

options.A: The mail servers responsible for handling mail delivery for a domain
options.B: An IP address for a domain name
options.C: An alias for a domain name
options.D: The authoritative name server for a domain

questions.explanation: MX records point to mail servers. An A record gives an IP, CNAME gives an alias and NS gives name servers.

questions.question: The analysis of an algorithm's complexity for the average case, considering all possible inputs, is called:
questions.explanation: Average-case analysis takes the expected cost over all inputs (with a probability distribution). Amortized analysis averages over a sequence of operations, not inputs.

questions.question: Which of the following is an example of a 'Greedy' algorithm?
questions.explanation: Kruskal's picks the minimum-weight edge that does not form a cycle at each step (greedy). Merge sort is divide and conquer; Knapsack 0/1 and Floyd-Warshall are DP.

questions.question: An LL(1) parser is a type of:
questions.explanation: LL(1): Left-to-right scan, Leftmost derivation, 1 lookahead; it is a predictive top-down parser. Shift-reduce and operator-precedence are bottom-up.

questions.question: In compiler design, 'Static Single Assignment' (SSA) form is an intermediate representation that:

options.A: Ensures every variable is assigned exactly once in the program text
options.C: Converts the program to machine code
options.D: Allows each variable to be read only once

questions.explanation: In SSA each variable has exactly one definition; phi functions merge values at join points. It simplifies data-flow optimisations.

questions.question: A 'Gray code' is a binary numeral system where two successive values differ in:
questions.explanation: Gray code (reflected binary) changes exactly one bit between consecutive values.

questions.question: The concept of 'micro-operations' in a CPU refers to:

options.C: The fundamental or atomic operations performed on data in registers during an instruction cycle

questions.explanation: Micro-operations are elementary register-transfer operations (e.g. MAR <- PC) that make up each phase of an instruction cycle.

questions.question: In programming, what is the purpose of a finally block in a try-catch statement?

options.A: To execute code only when there is no exception
options.B: To execute code only when there is an exception
options.D: To execute code regardless of whether an exception occurs or not

questions.explanation: finally always runs (except on abrupt JVM exit), so it is used for cleanup like closing files or connections.

questions.question: A class that has its dependencies injected from an external source, rather than creating them itself, is following which principle?
questions.explanation: DI is a form of IoC: control of creating dependencies moves outside the class, improving testability and loose coupling.

questions.question: 'Perfective Maintenance' in software engineering involves:

options.B: Adapting the software to a new environment
options.C: Preventing future problems by restructuring code
options.D: Improving the software by adding new features or enhancing existing ones at the user's request

questions.explanation: Corrective = bug fixes, adaptive = new environment, preventive = future-proofing, perfective = enhancements.

questions.question: A technique for gathering requirements by observing end-users as they perform their tasks is known as:
questions.explanation: Ethnography is observational requirements elicitation in the users' actual work environment.

questions.question: A 'zero-day' vulnerability is a software vulnerability that is:

options.A: Discovered on the first day of the software's release
options.B: Unknown to the developers, with no patch available
options.D: Fixed within a day of its discovery

questions.explanation: 'Zero-day' means the vendor has had zero days to fix it; attackers can exploit it before a patch exists.

questions.question: Which of the following is a difference between JSON and XML?

options.A: JSON does not use closing tags
options.B: JSON is typically less verbose and easier to parse
options.C: XML supports schema natively while JSON does not

questions.explanation: All are true: JSON has no closing tags, it is less verbose and easier to parse, and XML has native schema support (XSD) while JSON relies on the separate JSON Schema.

questions.question: What is 'Explainable AI' (XAI)?

options.A: AI that can generate human language
options.C: A set of AI methods and models that allow human users to understand and trust their results
options.D: AI that works without any training data

questions.explanation: XAI aims at transparency and interpretability of model decisions so humans can understand and trust them.

questions.question: An execution model where a cloud provider runs the server and dynamically manages the allocation of machine resources for a function is known as:
questions.explanation: In serverless/FaaS (e.g. AWS Lambda) the provider handles provisioning and scaling; you pay per execution.

questions.question: In an operating system, what is 'demand paging'?

options.A: A technique where all pages are pre-loaded
options.C: A technique where a page is brought into memory only when it is needed
options.D: A technique to compact free memory

questions.explanation: Demand paging loads pages lazily on a page fault, saving memory and load time.

questions.question: A thread that belongs to the user process and is not managed by the kernel is a:
questions.explanation: User-level threads are managed by a user-space library; the kernel sees only the process.

questions.question: Which of the following is a key-value store NoSQL database?
questions.explanation: Redis is a key-value store. MongoDB is document-based, Cassandra is wide-column and Neo4j is a graph database.

questions.question: A schedule is considered 'serializable' if:

options.B: It is equivalent to some serial execution of the transactions
options.C: It is always free from deadlocks
options.D: All its transactions execute in parallel

questions.explanation: Serializable means its effect equals some serial order. Conflicts may exist; serializability says nothing about deadlocks.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the Go-Back-N ARQ protocol?

options.C: To allow multiple packets to be sent at a time

questions.explanation: Go-Back-N is a sliding-window ARQ: it provides reliable transfer (retransmission), flow control (window size) and allows multiple frames in transit before an ACK.

questions.question: What is the primary function of a router in a network?

options.A: To connect devices within the same network
options.B: To forward data packets between different networks
options.D: To assign MAC addresses to devices

questions.explanation: A router works at Layer 3 and routes packets between networks. A switch connects devices within a LAN; a repeater regenerates signals.

questions.question: What is the time complexity of building a heap from an array of 'n' elements?
questions.explanation: Bottom-up heapify costs sum of node heights = O(n). Inserting elements one by one would be O(n log n).

questions.question: A 'topological sort' is possible only on which type of graph?
questions.explanation: Topological ordering requires directed edges and no cycles.

questions.question: What is a 'handle' in the context of bottom-up parsing?

options.A: A substring at the top of the stack that matches the right side of a production and whose reduction is a step of the rightmost derivation in reverse
options.D: The start symbol of the grammar

questions.explanation: Shift-reduce parsers find and reduce handles; each reduction reverses one step of a rightmost derivation.

questions.question: What does the term 'cross-compiler' mean?

options.A: A compiler that can compile multiple programming languages
options.B: A compiler that runs on one platform but generates code for another platform
options.C: A compiler that has been compiled by itself
options.D: A compiler that translates one high-level language to another

questions.explanation: A cross-compiler targets a different machine than the host (e.g. compiling ARM code on x86). Self-compiling is bootstrapping; HLL to HLL is a transpiler.

questions.question: An XOR gate can be used as a one-bit:
questions.explanation: With one input tied to 1, XOR inverts (A XOR 1 = A'); tied to 0 it buffers (A XOR 0 = A); and it outputs 1 when the two bits differ, acting as an inequality comparator.

questions.question: The addressing mode where the operand field holds the address of the location that contains the address of the actual data is called:
questions.explanation: In indirect addressing the instruction points to a memory word holding the effective address. In direct addressing the field itself is the data's address.

questions.question: In object-oriented programming, 'constructor chaining' refers to:

options.A: Calling one constructor from another within the same class
options.B: Calling a base class constructor from a derived class constructor

questions.explanation: Constructor chaining covers both this(...) calls within the same class and super(...) calls from a derived class to its base class.

questions.question: The 'Decorator' design pattern is used to:

options.A: Add new functionality to existing objects at runtime
options.B: Ensure a class has only one instance
options.C: Defer the steps of an algorithm to subclasses
options.D: Provide a simplified interface to a complex subsystem

questions.explanation: Decorator wraps objects to add behaviour dynamically. Singleton ensures one instance, Template Method defers steps, Facade simplifies an interface.

questions.question: The primary goal of 'Risk Management' in software engineering is to:

options.B: Identify and mitigate potential problems before they can adversely affect the project
options.D: Transfer all risks to the client

questions.explanation: Risks can rarely be eliminated; risk management identifies, analyses, plans for and monitors them.

questions.question: 'Smoke Testing' is a type of software testing that:

options.A: Tests the security of the software
options.B: Tests the usability of the software
options.C: Tests the software under extreme load
options.D: Determines if a new build of the software is stable enough for further testing

questions.explanation: Smoke (build verification) testing checks critical functions quickly before deeper testing. Load testing is a separate non-functional test.

questions.question: A 'stateful' firewall maintains what information?

options.A: Only the source and destination IP addresses
options.C: The state of active connections, such as TCP handshakes
options.D: The browsing history of each user

questions.explanation: A stateful firewall tracks connection state tables, unlike stateless packet filters that inspect each packet's headers in isolation.

questions.question: 'WebSocket' technology enables what kind of communication between a client and a server?

options.C: Full-duplex, bidirectional communication over a single TCP connection

questions.explanation: WebSocket upgrades an HTTP connection to a persistent, full-duplex TCP channel for real-time apps.

questions.question: In machine learning, a confusion matrix is used to evaluate the performance of which type of model?
questions.explanation: A confusion matrix tabulates TP, FP, TN, FN for classifiers. Regression uses MSE/R^2.

questions.question: What is 'Edge Computing'?

options.A: Computing that is done near the source of the data, instead of in a remote, centralized cloud
options.C: An older name for cloud computing

questions.explanation: Edge computing processes data close to where it is generated (IoT devices, gateways) to reduce latency and bandwidth.

questions.question: A situation where a higher priority task is indirectly preempted by a lower priority task is known as:
questions.explanation: Priority inversion happens when a low-priority task holds a resource needed by a high-priority task (solved by priority inheritance).

questions.question: The ETL process in data warehousing stands for:
questions.explanation: ETL = Extract data from sources, Transform it, Load it into the warehouse.

questions.question: The Address Resolution Protocol (ARP) operates at which layer?

options.D: Between the Network Layer and Data Link Layer

questions.explanation: ARP maps IP (Layer 3) addresses to MAC (Layer 2) addresses, so it works at the boundary of these two layers.

questions.question: Bellman-Ford algorithm can be used in which of the following scenarios where Dijkstra's algorithm fails?

options.C: When the graph has negative weight edges

questions.explanation: Dijkstra's greedy choice breaks with negative edges. Bellman-Ford handles them and can detect negative cycles.

questions.question: A problem is considered 'NP-Complete' if it is:
questions.explanation: NP-Complete = in NP AND NP-Hard. Being only one of them is not enough.

questions.question: What is the Document Object Model (DOM)?

options.B: A programming interface that represents HTML or XML documents as a tree structure
options.D: A database for storing web pages

questions.explanation: The DOM is a language-neutral API that models a document as a tree of nodes that scripts can read and modify.

questions.question: What is the value of (10101) base 2 in decimal?
A T flip-flop is created by connecting together the inputs of which flip-flop?
questions.explanation: Tying J and K together gives T: T=0 holds, T=1 toggles.

questions.question: In a complete graph with 'n' vertices, how many edges are there?
questions.explanation: Every pair of vertices is connected: nC2 = n(n-1)/2. n - 1 is the edge count of a tree.

questions.question: A data structure that follows the Last-In, First-Out (LIFO) principle is the:
questions.explanation: Stack is LIFO; queue is FIFO.

questions.question: Shortest Remaining Time First (SRTF) is the preemptive version of which scheduling algorithm?
questions.explanation: SRTF is preemptive SJF: a newly arrived job with a shorter remaining time preempts the running one.

questions.question: In SQL, what does the TRUNCATE TABLE command do?

options.A: Quickly removes all rows from a table but keeps the table structure
options.B: Completely removes the table from the database
options.C: Removes only some rows from the table

questions.explanation: TRUNCATE (DDL) deletes all rows quickly; DROP removes the table; DELETE with WHERE removes selected rows.

questions.question: The Hamming code is a type of:
questions.explanation: Hamming code (SEC-DED variant) can detect up to 2-bit errors and correct 1-bit errors, so it is both error-detecting and error-correcting.

questions.question: 'Story Points' in Agile development are a unit used to estimate:

options.A: The effort required to implement a user story
options.B: The time required to implement a user story
options.C: The business value of a user story

questions.explanation: Story points are relative measures of effort (complexity, uncertainty, work), not hours or business value.

questions.question: In C++, dynamic memory allocation is done using which operator?
questions.explanation: C++ uses the new operator (and delete to free). malloc() is a C library function, not an operator.

questions.question: 'Deepfake' technology primarily uses which type of machine learning model?
questions.explanation: Deepfakes are typically produced with GANs (and autoencoders), where a generator and discriminator compete to make realistic media.

questions.question: Which of the following is a component of the operating system?
questions.explanation: File management, process management and memory management are all core components of an OS.

questions.question: The 'bus' in computer architecture refers to a:

options.D: Communication system that transfers data between components of a computer

questions.explanation: A bus is a set of shared lines (address, data, control) connecting CPU, memory and I/O.

questions.question: The HTTP status code '401 Unauthorized' means:

options.A: Authentication is required for the request
options.B: The requested resource was not found
options.C: The server refuses to fulfill the request despite authentication
options.D: The server encountered an internal error

questions.explanation: 401 = missing/invalid authentication. 404 = not found, 403 = forbidden, 500 = internal server error.

questions.question: A 'daemon' in a UNIX-like operating system is a:

options.C: Process that runs in the background, not under the direct control of a user

questions.explanation: Daemons (e.g. sshd, crond) are background service processes. A zombie is a terminated process not yet reaped by its parent.
